directive: master qualification §28/§30 (Phase 3) — quote-age sensitivity + execution models

determinism.e3_draw_order: settled covered decisions sorted by (made_ts, ticker)

conventions.fee: fee_c = 7 * (a/100) * (1 - a/100) per contract at executed ask a; ceil-at-order-level convention kept ceil-free fractional because everything is per-$1 (1-contract order, fractional fee)
conventions.ev_per_dollar: (100*win - ask - fee)/ask per trade, averaged; win is the OBSERVED settled outcome

decision_set.source: results/pt_trades.jsonl (champion) joined to results/kalshi_binary_log.jsonl variant=kb — OBSERVED
decision_set.note: Windows without kb path coverage are excluded — the kb log retains only recent windows; excluded decisions are counted, never interpolated.

quote_age.provenance: DERIVED — repricing of OBSERVED decisions against the OBSERVED per-minute quote path at MODELED asks
quote_age.definition: staleness Δ: the SAME side priced at the quote Δ minutes BEFORE the decision minute (older/staler quote); delay Δ: at the quote Δ minutes AFTER (delayed execution). Δ=0 is the E1 baseline. Points with no minute row are excluded per point.

E2_calibrated.label: DERIVED — measured mean slippage_vs_model_c from execution_ledger.json (n=134) — modeled ask minus the measured ~2.0c overstatement

E3_stress.label: STRESS — modeled ask + 2.5c (double spread) and 10% seeded random no-fill

oracle_mid_fill.label: NON-REALISTIC — diagnostic only, never for qualification (fill at mid = 100p)

verdict.crossing_definition: first tested Δ where curve EV < E1 baseline EV minus 0.01 $/1 (1c per $1)
verdict.summary: Champion edge FAILS under E2 (-0.0066/$1) and FAILS under E3 stress (-0.0557/$1); staleness EV first drops >1c/$1 below the E1 baseline (-0.0343/$1) at no tested staleness (<=5 min).
